What types of crises does SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL respond to?

SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL responds to a variety of crises, including those caused by conflicts and violence, epidemics, natural disasters, climate-related events, and economic collapse. Our teams are dedicated to providing immediate assistance to affected populations, ensuring their basic needs are met and helping them rebuild their lives.

How does SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL support water and sanitation needs?

Water and sanitation are critical areas of focus for SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL. We implement programs that provide access to clean drinking water, improve sanitation facilities, and promote hygiene practices. Our teams work to restore and rehabilitate water supply systems, ensuring that communities have sustainable access to safe water, which is essential for health and well-being.

What role does agriculture play in SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL's initiatives?

Agriculture is a key component of our efforts to support vulnerable populations. We promote sustainable agricultural practices that enhance food security and livelihoods. Our programs include providing training, resources, and support to farmers, helping them to increase their productivity and resilience against future shocks, whether they be environmental or economic.

How can individuals contribute to SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL's mission?

Individuals can contribute to our mission in several ways, including making financial donations, fundraising, or volunteering their time and skills. Every contribution helps us provide essential services to those in need. Additionally, spreading awareness about our work and the challenges faced by affected populations can also make a significant impact.

What measures does SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL take to ensure the safety of its teams and beneficiaries?

The safety of our teams and beneficiaries is a top priority for SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL. We conduct thorough risk assessments before deploying teams to crisis areas and implement security protocols tailored to the specific context. Our staff receives training on safety and security measures, and we maintain close communication with local authorities and other organizations to ensure a coordinated response.

Can you provide examples of successful projects implemented by SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL?

SOLIDARITÉS INTERNATIONAL has successfully implemented numerous projects across various sectors. For example, in response to a recent natural disaster, we restored water supply systems in affected communities, providing access to clean water for thousands of people. In another initiative, we supported farmers in conflict-affected regions by providing training and resources to improve agricultural practices, leading to increased food production and enhanced livelihoods.

About AFA Press
---------------

AFA Press specialises in delivering the content and tools needed for the production of special reports that promote dynamic emerging markets in the global arena. The first independent press and communications agency of its kind, AFA Press was founded in 1970 by Alberto Llaryora and has offices in London, New York and Madrid. AFA Press provides services to several independent agencies that produce country, regional, sectorial and theme-based reports for print and digital media. These agencies each have exclusive distribution agreements with leading newspapers worldwide, ensuring that the special reports they produce reach affluent and influential target audiences. Through these agencies AFA Press has contributed to producing special reports on subjects as far flung as OPEC, the wine industry in France and country reports on more than 180 countries around the globe.  
  
Over the years AFA Press has rapidly expanded, establishing a solid relationship with governments and the private sector in the countries in which our partner agencies operate. We pride ourselves on our independence and on the integrity of our editorial content, which has positioned us as the number one company in our field. Our international scope and experience has given us in-depth knowledge and expertise in understanding a broad range of cultures and ways of doing business.

About Essen BioScience
----------------------

The Sartorius Group is a leading international partner of life science research and the biopharmaceutical industry providing solutions from small to the most complex customized workflows. We are helping biotech scientists and engineers across the entire globe to develop and manufacture medications from the first idea to production. So, more people will have access to better medicine.  
  
In 2017, Sartorius extended its BioAnalytics portfolio with the acquisition of Essen BioScience Inc., a pioneer and leader in the field of cell-based assays and instrumentation used for drug discovery and basic research applications.  
  
Founded in Ann Arbor, Michigan in 1996, Essen BioScience develops and manufactures instruments, software, reagents, and consumables that enable researchers to remotely image and quantify a wide variety of cellular processes over time. Such novel analytical methods are crucial to enable scientific progress in the rapidly advancing areas of immuno-oncology, antibody discovery, stem cell research, and beyond.  
  
At this channel, we will keep you updated on the newest developments and most exciting trends in the field, while also giving insights into technical details and performance of our Incucyte® product range.  
  
Empower Your Research with Incucyte® Live-Cell Analysis  
  
The Incucyte Live-Cell Analysis system is designed to efficiently capture cellular changes where they happen—in the incubator. Capture high-resolution images and record data in real time over days, weeks, or even months. From proliferation assays to immune killing of tumor spheroids, this flexible system enables users to observe and quantify complex biological changes in real time. Integrated software simplifies data analysis to speed time to answer while producing publication-quality graphs and plots.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Tallwave Capital

What types of services does Tallwave Capital offer?

Tallwave Capital specializes in providing strategic investment and advisory services. Our offerings include venture capital funding, growth equity investments, and operational support for startups and emerging companies. We focus on helping businesses scale by providing not only financial resources but also strategic guidance and access to our extensive network.

Which industries does Tallwave Capital primarily invest in?

Tallwave Capital primarily invests in technology-driven sectors, including software, healthcare, fintech, and consumer products. We seek out innovative companies that leverage technology to disrupt traditional markets and create significant value. Our team has deep expertise in these industries, allowing us to provide tailored support to our portfolio companies.

How does Tallwave Capital support portfolio companies beyond funding?

Beyond providing capital, Tallwave Capital is committed to the long-term success of our portfolio companies. We offer operational support, strategic planning, and mentorship to help businesses navigate challenges and seize growth opportunities. Our team works closely with founders and management teams to refine their business models, enhance their go-to-market strategies, and build strong organizational capabilities.

What is the typical investment size for Tallwave Capital?

Tallwave Capital typically invests between $500,000 and $5 million in early to growth-stage companies. Our investment size may vary depending on the specific needs of the business and the stage of development. We aim to provide sufficient capital to help companies achieve their next milestones while also ensuring alignment with our investment strategy.

How can startups apply for funding from Tallwave Capital?

Startups interested in applying for funding from Tallwave Capital can submit their business plan or pitch deck through our website's contact form. We review all submissions carefully and look for innovative ideas, strong market potential, and capable management teams. If we find a potential fit, we will reach out to schedule a meeting to discuss the opportunity further.

What is Tallwave Capital's approach to risk management in investments?

Tallwave Capital employs a rigorous risk management approach that includes thorough due diligence, market analysis, and ongoing monitoring of our portfolio companies. We assess potential risks associated with each investment, including market dynamics, competitive landscape, and operational challenges. Our experienced team works collaboratively with portfolio companies to mitigate risks and adapt to changing market conditions.

About Pumps & Pipes
-------------------

On a flight out of Houston, a cardiovascular surgeon and the passenger next to him, a drilling engineer, struck up a conversation about their respective professions, discussing a range of topics from blood vessels to extended-reach wells. As the exchange progressed, the heart doctor and engineer realized that underneath the specialized verbiage of each of their industries—whether drilling for oil or performing heart surgery —it’s all a matter of pumps and pipes.  
  
Since 2007, Houston Methodist DeBakey Heart & Vascular Center, NASA, University of Houston, and now Rice University, have collaborated on the Pumps & Pipes Symposium. This annual event brings together innovators in the energy, medical, academia and aerospace industries, as well as venture capitalists and equipment manufacturers, to exchange ideas and explore crossover technologies.  
  
Our mission is Threefold:  
  
\* Provide a platform to bring together professional groups who may not otherwise have the opportunity to interact for the transfer of knowledge and technology know-how  
  
\* Be the leader in promoting cross-industry collaboration to solve challenging Pumps & Pipes problems  
  
\* Help strengthen the educational offerings in science, technology, engineering, art, and mathematics (STEAM)

About Hervé BRISSE

Hervé Brisse, MD, PhD, has been at the forefront of oncology imaging as the Head of the Imaging Department at Institut Curie since January 2014. His extensive expertise spans pediatric imaging, pediatric oncology, onco-ophthalmology, and sarcoma imaging, making him a pivotal figure in advancing diagnostic and interventional radiology practices. Under his leadership, the Imaging Department has become a cornerstone of the comprehensive cancer care provided at Institut Curie, which integrates cutting-edge medical and research facilities to tackle the complexities of cancer treatment.  
  
Dr. Brisse is particularly renowned for his contributions to clinical trials evaluation, where he employs advanced imaging techniques to assess treatment efficacy and safety in pediatric populations. His commitment to radiation protection ensures that the delicate balance between diagnostic accuracy and patient safety is maintained, particularly in vulnerable groups such as children. His role also involves the implementation of DICOM standards and the optimization of Picture Archiving and Communication Systems (PACS), enhancing the efficiency and accessibility of imaging data for clinical decision-making.  
  
In addition to his clinical responsibilities, Dr. Brisse is deeply engaged in academic pursuits, contributing to the advancement of cancer research through publications and collaborations. His work not only improves patient outcomes but also shapes the future of pediatric oncology imaging, positioning him as a thought leader in the field. As he continues to navigate the challenges of oncology imaging, Dr. Brisse remains dedicated to fostering innovation and excellence at Institut Curie, ensuring that the institution remains at the cutting edge of cancer care and research.

SecurionPay, established in 2014 in Switzerland, is a cross-device payment platform that enables businesses accepting online payments in 160 currencies through the checkout translated into 23 languages.  
  
From the very beginning, we strived to become the developers’ most favorable payment solution, delivering powerful API and the flexibility that everyone is looking for today. Our clients get full control over the development process and can easily integrate based on their setup, programming language, etc. It gives merchants limitless possibilities to create any payment scenario for their business.  
  
The heart of our solution is user experience. We care about both the merchant’s experience in implementing our payments and the customer’s experience during the checkout process. What’s more, we are focused on conversions. Our entire design and simplified user flow, as well as security features, are built to minimize cart abandonment and increase sales.  
  
In addition, we are expanding the solution to give clients new paths for revenue development with Cross-Sales, One-Click Payments or Subscription Payments. We employ a very transparent pricing structure with ‘no hidden fees guarantee.’ We don’t charge any setup or monthly recurring fees, so clients pay only once they start accepting payments.  
  
Finally, we are at the forefront of security for our clients. We provide anti-fraud tools, built-in machine learning capabilities to detect fraud, our non-invasive 3D Secure that reduces chargebacks without decreasing conversion and even more.  
  
In short, our payment platform is technologically advanced but easy to use at the same time. Find out more at https://securionpay.com/.

The company’s application enables patients to communicate with their own physicians via IM sessions and receive responses to their questions and concerns; and physicians and institutions to connect and communicate with their staff, partners, other care providers, and patients. Its application also provides solutions to hospitals on various issues, such as unnecessary and preventable readmissions; and allows them to download the records of their confidential conversations with patients to place in the EMR. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Mercer Island, Washington.

About Co-Impact
---------------

Co-Impact is a global collaborative focused on systems change to improve the lives of millions by advancing education, improving people’s health, and providing economic opportunity.  
  
Co-Impact brings together a group of results-oriented funders and program partners who are pooling resources, networks, and expertise to enable lasting change at scale.  
  
We invest in systems change efforts in low and middle-income countries that are working to address underlying conditions that perpetuate social inequities. Our approach builds on and supports the work and experience of civil society, government and philanthropic partners, and each one of our first grants has been developed in partnership with others. By collaborating, and creating a platform for others to join, Co-Impact and its partners seek to achieve far more together than possible alone. To find out more, please visit co-impact.org or follow us on Twitter: @CoImpactCollab  
  
Co-Impact is fiscally sponsored by New Venture Fund, a U.S.-based, 501(c)(3) public charity. U.S.-based staff are employed through NVF, while U.K. staff are employed through a professional employer organization.

---------------

We are a natural clothing company that designs beautiful apparel, as pure in its creation as it is a pleasure to wear.  
  
The principles we live by are the principles that guide the way we do business. That may sound pretentious (we hope not!), but there is no simpler way to say that the authenticity of our heritage, our compassion and respect toward our planet and its people, the natural processes we employ in the creation of our clothing, are the essence of who we are.  
  
Our goal is to be 100% organic in everything we make. All of our pure cotton is 100% organic. The availability of the other luxurious, natural fibers we use in organic quality is still limited. 20-55% of our range in these fabrics is organic. However, everything we make is pure and natural. Made by people whose human rights are respected. We are very proud of what we have accomplished in the years since we began. But as Heinz Hess, our founder, might have said: “You aren’t on the mountain top until you finish the climb.”

As the Principal Technical Product Manager for Sustainability in Amazon Private Brands, Natalie Hollier plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of sustainable practices within one of the world's largest e-commerce platforms. Her current focus is on leading the technology strategy and roadmap for sustainability initiatives within the Amazon Private Brands supply chain.  
  
In this capacity, Natalie collaborates with a diverse array of stakeholders, including Worldwide Sustainability, Retail, and third-party technology providers, to develop innovative solutions that enhance the sustainability metrics of Amazon-made products. Her expertise in green technology and analytical skills allows her to effectively measure and improve environmental impacts, ensuring that Amazon's private label offerings align with the company's broader sustainability goals.  
  
Key projects under her leadership include the integration of advanced data analytics to track carbon footprints and the implementation of user research methodologies to understand consumer preferences for sustainable products. Natalie's ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders has been instrumental in fostering cross-functional partnerships that drive impactful change. Additionally, her commitment to people development ensures that her team is equipped with the skills necessary to navigate the evolving landscape of sustainable business practices. Through her innovative approach and strategic vision, Natalie is not only advancing Amazon's sustainability initiatives but also setting a benchmark for the industry at large.

About Audiovox
--------------

Audiovox Corporation, through its subsidiaries, operates as a distributor and value added service provider in the accessory, mobile, and consumer electronics industries. The company sells mobile multi-media video products, including in-dash, overhead, headrest, and portable mobile video systems; autosound products comprising radios, speakers, amplifiers, and CD changers; satellite radios, such as plug and play models, and direct connect models; automotive security and remote start systems; and automotive power accessories. It also offers rear observation and collision avoidance systems; liquid crystal display flat panel televisions; home and portable stereos; two-way radios; digital multi-media products, including personal video recorders and MP3 products; camcorders; clock-radios; digital voice recorders; home speaker systems; portable DVD players; and digital picture frames. In addition, the company sells high-definition television and wireless fidelity antennas, high-definition multimedia interface accessories, home electronic accessories, other connectivity products, power cords, performance enhancing electronics, TV universal remotes, flat panel TV mounting systems, iPod specialized products, wireless headphones, rechargeable battery backups (UPS), and power supply systems. Further, it provides value added management services, which include product design and development, engineering and testing, sales training and customer packaging, instore display design, installation training and technical support, product repair services and warranty, nationwide installation network, and warehousing. The company sells its products to power retailers, mass merchants, regional chain stores, specialty and Internet retailers, independent 12 volt retailers, distributors, new car dealers, vehicle equipment manufacturers, and the U.S. military. Audiovox Corporation was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Hauppauge, New York.

About The Smith Consulting Group, LLC
-------------------------------------

Our firm specializes in retained search for consulting engineering firms and architecture and planning firms seeking licensed professional engineers and land surveyors, architects, landscape architects and urban planners, and all disciplines within the A/E/C niche.  
  
Our company prides itself on networking with the candidates that are not actively looking, but who will entertain the right opportunity when it is presented to them by a professional. We also have contacts with our clients who, in most instances, do not post every job opening. Instead, they utilize our firm to act as silent talent scouts on their behalf.  
  
The Smith Consulting Group has aligned itself with one of the top recruiting networks in the nation, Sanford Rose Associates. What this means to our clients is access to many more candidates than any one firm can surface, but still maintaining one point of contact. What this means to our candidates is access to more job opportunities in more markets!  
  
Either way, if your company is searching for an A-player to build your organization or if you are an A-player looking to upgrade your career, you should be talking with one of our recruiters. Her leadership is characterized by a commitment to enhancing the student experience beyond academic delivery, with a strong focus on community building, global engagement, and fostering partnerships that enrich the educational journey.

She has spearheaded initiatives that promote equity, diversity, and inclusion (EDI), ensuring that all students feel valued and supported in their career aspirations. By implementing structured programs that connect students with industry leaders and alumni, Lisa is dedicated to bridging the gap between academic learning and real-world application, empowering students to navigate their career paths effectively.  
  
Lisa’s expertise in strategy development and program management is complemented by her skills in financial modeling and budget management, enabling her to allocate resources efficiently and maximize impact. Her ability to cultivate high-performing teams and mentor emerging leaders has been instrumental in fostering a culture of collaboration and excellence within the school. About Anwar Almojarkesh

Anwar Almojarkesh is a visionary leader and the driving force behind Innovation Factory Limited, where he serves as CEO and Founder. With a profound expertise in non-speech sound classification and deep learning, Anwar has positioned his company at the forefront of technological innovation. His journey began when he was awarded a Tier 1 Exceptional Talent visa by the UK government in 2016, a prestigious accolade granted to only 200 individuals globally each year, recognizing his contributions to the field of sound classification.  
  
Under Anwar's leadership, Innovation Factory Limited has made significant strides in developing advanced solutions that enhance everyday life through technology. One of the flagship projects, Braci Ltd., exemplifies this mission by creating a groundbreaking system capable of detecting a diverse array of sounds, including smoke alarms, doorbells, baby cries, and car horns. This innovative solution translates these auditory signals into easily understandable notifications, seamlessly integrating with smart devices to improve safety and accessibility for users both indoors and outdoors.  
  
Anwar's expertise extends beyond sound classification; he is also well-versed in deep learning, solar energy, and power electronics, making him a multifaceted leader in the tech industry. His skills in research, simulations, and mobile device technology further bolster his ability to drive projects that merge functionality with user-centric design. With a commitment to leveraging technology for social good, Anwar Almojarkesh continues to inspire innovation and push the boundaries of what is possible in sound recognition and beyond.

About OSS Health
----------------

Welcome to OSS Health! We are a physician-owned orthopaedic group based in York, PA with offices also located in West York, Hanover, Mechanicsburg, Gettysburg and Columbia.  
  
As a leader of orthopaedics in Central, PA, we offer a full range of orthopaedic services with highly trained physicians and staff, who are committed to providing high quality orthopaedic healthcare - from the diagnosis and treatment to surgery and rehabilitation.  
  
OSS Health services include adult and pediatric orthopaedic care, fracture care, spine and joint care, sports medicine, pain management, podiatry, orthopaedic urgent care, workers’ compensation, imaging, home health, Primary Care and rehabilitation. Our goal is to get our patients back to an active lifestyle and doing the everyday activities they love.  
  
We are also the home of OSS Orthopaedic Hospital, a unique specialty hospital - located on the Powder Mill Road campus in York. Our hospital has 26 private rooms and 4 state-of-the-art operating suites. Patients enjoy excellent clinical outcomes, low infection and complication rates, and an outstanding patient experience. The OSS Hospital is dedicated exclusively to orthopaedic surgeries including hip and knee replacements, shoulder surgery, spine surgery, sports medicine surgeries and more.  
  
OSS Health Orthopaedic Urgent Care is offered at our Powder Mill, West York, Hanover and Mechanicsburg locations. We are here for patients who endure unexpected injuries and need to be seen by an orthopaedic provider. Patients now have the option to save their spot in line for our orthopaedic urgent care, so they can visit our offices at a time that is convenient for them.  
  
Want to be a member of our team? APPLY TODAY to OSS HEALTH!!  
  
To apply for available jobs visit www.osshealth.com/careers. Just fill out the online application and submit it! All job details are viewable on the website.

About Ervia
-----------

Ervia is a commercial semi-state company who is responsible for three companies; Aurora, Gas Networks Ireland and Irish Water, which specialise in dark fibre solutions, gas and water infrastructure and services.  
  
• Aurora Telecom is a carrier-neutral operator specialising in Dark Fibre services for customers seeking a future proof high bandwidth solution. Aurora is focused on the design and build of bespoke dedicated fibre network solutions. For further information; www.aurora.ie.  
  
• Gas Networks Ireland owns, operates, builds and maintains the natural gas network in Ireland and connects all customers to it. Their core purpose is to ensure that over 673,000 homes and businesses receive a safe, efficient and secure supply of natural gas, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. For further information; www.gasnetworks.ie.  
  
• Irish Water was established in 2012. On 1st January 2014, Irish Water fully took over responsibility for public water and wastewater services from 31 Local Authorities and began the process of transforming the delivery of water services nationally to a single national public water utility. Irish Water is now responsible for:  
\- Management and maintenance of all public national water and wastewater assets;  
\- National water services investment and planning;  
\- Managing public water capital investment projects;  
\- Irish Water Customer Care and billing. (Following a recent Government decision, domestic billing is due to be suspended for 9 months, pending a review of charges).  
You can find out more about Irish Water on www.water.ie.  
  
Ervia primarily operates out of Cork and Dublin and also has regional offices across Ireland. We employ 1,600 staff nationwide.

Taylor Management Company is an Accredited Association Management Company providing full service property management to over 300 residential community associations throughout New Jersey, Pennsylvania and New York since 1996. We do not represent or serve any developers and have no conflict of interest relationship with the developer community. This allows us to pursue all deficiencies, financial and physical, existing at the association that is the responsibility of the developer and to focus our concerns on the needs of the unit owners. Owner, Paul A. Santoriello, is a Professional Manager of Community Associations (PCAM) and a Certified Manager of Community Associations (CMCA). About Cambria Automobiles plc
-----------------------------

Cambria was incorporated in March 2006 with the objective of creating an independent UK motor dealership group representing both the volume, premium and luxury segments of the motor vehicle market through a "buy and build"​ strategy.  
  
The company is a retailer of new and used cars, commercial vehicles and motorbikes.  
  
Our Culture  
  
Each Cambria Automobiles Management team are empowered to run their own business, with access to expertise in our support functions, they drive to perform through an autonomous culture. Cambria has no costly Head Office and minimal management layers; the proof of the success of this culture is both real and tangible.  
  
All the businesses in Cambria Automobiles share the same values, which underpin all operational and strategic decisions, through 'The Four Pillars'​. If it does not achieve one of these then it will not happen.  
  
Associate Delight  
  
Members of the team will not be referred to as members of staff or employees. The associate will be proud to be associated with the Group and will be rewarded on contribution to the Four Pillars.  
  
All associates should feel empowered and have autonomy to make decisions that affect the running of the business.  
  
Associates will feel that they can achieve all their career aspiration with Cambria, correspondingly Cambria will invest in its associates in order that they can achieve their full potential.  
  
Guest Delight  
  
All associates will be encouraged to treat all customers at all times in the way that they would treat a guest coming into their own home.  
  
Associate empowerment is key to achieving this goal. The organisation will be transparent and open at all times empathising with a diverse guest base.  
  
Guests should feel that they have enjoyed their experience of 'touch-pointing'​ with associates and that it is an experience that they would wish to repeat.  
  
Brand Delight  
  
The Group's goal is to become the retailer of choice for all the brands that they represent.  
  
This is focused around the following drivers:  
•To achieve brand vehicle sales objectives  
•To achieve brand part sales objectives  
•To be in the top half of brand customer satisfaction surveys  
•To develop an open and trusting relationship with all brand personnel  
  
Stakeholder Delight  
  
The Group's goal is to focus on delivering delight for its stakeholders:  
•To deliver all financial and non-financial criteria agreed with stakeholders  
•To be open and transparent in all communication to ensure a trusting relationship  
•To provide timely and accurate information so the stakeholders understand business performance.

About Greg Schechter

As the Chief Executive Officer of Schechter Natural History, Greg Schechter is at the helm of an innovative venture that bridges technology and the natural world. With a robust background as an entrepreneur and engineering leader, Greg has harnessed his expertise in full-stack product engineering to spearhead groundbreaking projects that redefine how we explore and understand biodiversity. Under his leadership, the company is developing cutting-edge digital field guides, with the flagship project being the "Guide to Reptiles and Amphibians of North America." This comprehensive resource features detailed illustrations and information on over 700 species, making it an invaluable tool for both amateur naturalists and seasoned researchers alike.  
  
Greg’s journey began at the University of Illinois in Urbana-Champaign, where he not only honed his technical skills but also contributed to the Opera Web Standards Curriculum. His entrepreneurial spirit led him to create a company focused on coursework scheduling, a testament to his ability to identify and address gaps in existing systems. This blend of technical acumen and business insight has been instrumental in driving Schechter Natural History's mission to empower modern explorers with accessible, scientifically accurate information.  
  
With a strong command of technologies such as React.js, JavaScript, and Python, Greg is committed to leveraging web development and mobile applications to enhance user engagement and learning experiences. His vision for Schechter Natural History is clear: to create a platform that not only educates but also inspires a deeper appreciation for the natural world, ensuring that every explorer is equipped with the knowledge they need to make meaningful discoveries.

About Seton Education Partners
------------------------------

Seton Education Partners is a transformative organization dedicated to enhancing educational opportunities for families in underserved communities across the United States. Headquartered in New York City, Seton operates under the conviction that every child deserves access to an academically excellent, character-rich education, particularly within the framework of a vibrant Catholic ethos. Founded on the belief that urban Catholic schools hold immense potential for revitalization, Seton Education Partners is committed to preserving and enhancing this vital educational resource.  
  
The organization recognizes the significant challenges facing these schools, yet it approaches them with an entrepreneurial spirit and innovative strategies designed to foster growth and sustainability. By partnering with local communities, Seton works to empower parents, giving them the choice of a quality education for their children. This commitment not only aims to strengthen the educational foundation for thousands of children but also to cultivate a sense of community and shared values.  
  
For those interested in the teaching staff, the Seton Education Partners teachers list showcases a diverse group of dedicated educators who are passionate about their mission. These teachers are integral to the success of the schools, bringing expertise and a commitment to fostering both academic excellence and moral development. Through collaborative efforts and a focus on continuous improvement, Seton Education Partners is paving the way for a brighter future for students in America’s most underserved neighborhoods, ensuring that they have the tools and support necessary to thrive.

Sheltr makes home maintenance effortless with one simple subscription.  
  
We help homeowners proactively care for their homes to catch and mitigate issues before they become costly repairs. Members receive twice annual Home Checkups for preventative maintenance to proactively mitigate and identify issues - like a physical, for your house. Sheltr provides recommendations based on the assessment and coordinates service with a network of vetted and high-quality service providers. Sheltr is available on-demand for text/image tele-maintenance and fixed-rate, transparent on-demand service  
  
A flooded bathroom, an unexpected appliance failure, or clogged gutters - home care today is completely reactive. 69% of homeowners don’t anticipate a major home repair emergency in the next year despite 59% reporting experiencing one in the previous year. Like your health, your pets, or your car, your home requires regular maintenance to keep it running smoothly and working properly.  
  
Our mission is to use technology and predictive analytics to make maintaining, improving, and repairing your home proactive and preventative - saving you stress, time and money.

What services does Sheltr offer to homeowners?

Sheltr provides a comprehensive home maintenance subscription service that includes regular inspections, preventive maintenance, and access to a network of qualified home service professionals. Members benefit from twice-yearly home check-ups, seasonal maintenance reminders, and discounts on repairs and services, ensuring their homes remain in optimal condition.

How does the subscription model work for Sheltr?

Sheltr operates on a subscription basis, allowing homeowners to choose a plan that best fits their needs. Subscribers pay a monthly or annual fee, which grants them access to all the services offered, including routine maintenance checks, emergency support, and exclusive discounts on home repairs. This model helps homeowners budget for maintenance costs and avoid unexpected expenses.

What types of issues can Sheltr help prevent?

Sheltr focuses on preventing a wide range of home maintenance issues, including plumbing leaks, HVAC system failures, roof damage, and electrical problems. By conducting regular inspections and maintenance, Sheltr helps homeowners identify potential issues early, allowing for timely interventions that can save money and prevent costly repairs down the line.

Is Sheltr available in my area?

Sheltr is expanding its services across various regions. To check if Sheltr is available in your area, visit our website and enter your zip code. If we currently do not operate in your location, we encourage you to sign up for updates, as we are continually working to expand our service coverage.

How does Sheltr ensure quality in the home service professionals it partners with?

Sheltr partners with a network of vetted and qualified home service professionals. Each partner undergoes a rigorous screening process, including background checks, licensing verification, and customer reviews. This ensures that our members receive high-quality service from trusted professionals who are committed to maintaining the integrity of their homes.

Can I customize my Sheltr subscription plan?

Yes, Sheltr offers customizable subscription plans to meet the unique needs of each homeowner. Members can choose from various service options, including the frequency of inspections, types of maintenance covered, and additional services such as emergency repairs. This flexibility allows homeowners to tailor their plan to fit their specific home maintenance requirements.

Woningcorporatie DUWO is gespecialiseerd in studentenhuisvesting. We vinden wonen een essentieel onderdeel van het studentenleven en een voorwaarde voor een onvergetelijke studententijd, ook voor de buitenlandse studenten die voor korte tijd in Nederland studeren. Ons belangrijkste doel is dan ook te zorgen dat studenten voldoende, kwalitatief passende en betaalbare huisvesting hebben.  
  
DUWO ontwikkelt, bouwt en beheert studentenhuisvesting in eigen bezit of in samenwerking met partners.  
Met 31.000 kamers en woningen en vestigingen in Amsterdam, Delft, Den Haag, Deventer, Leiden en Wageningen is DUWO in Nederland de grootste aanbieder van studentenhuisvesting.  
  
DUWO was ook de eerste studentenhuisvester van Nederland. Op alle terreinen werken we hard aan innovatie. Zo kan onze jonge, dynamische doelgroep 24/7 digitaal zijn zaken afhandelen op onze website: van het zoeken van een kamer tot het tekenen van het huurcontract.

About DFW BUSINESS GROUP ON HEALTH
----------------------------------

The DFW Business Group on Health (DFWBGH) is a regional coalition of 65 large and mid-size DFW area employers committed to improving health care quality, costs, and outcomes in North Texas. DFWBGH members spend over $4 billion annually in DFW on healthcare for nearly 1 million local employees and their families. Members include American Airlines, BNSF Railway, Celanese, City of Fort Worth, Fluor Corp., Greyhound Lines, JCPenney, Lennox International, The Neiman Marcus Group, Oncor Electric Delivery, Southwest Airlines, Texas Instruments, and Vistra Energy, and others. DFWBGH’s mission is to educate and empower employers and their employees to make informed healthcare decisions and encourage healthcare providers to continuously improve their performance.  
  
DFWBGH is proud to be a Leapfrog Group Regional Leader since 2001. DFWBGH is Leapfrog's voice in the DFW region driving change and improving safety and value for DFWBGH members by using Leapfrog's tools and encouraging local hospitals to report their quality and safety practices to the Leapfrog Hospital Survey. The Leapfrog Group members include Fortune 100 companies, consumer advocacy groups, and regional business coalitions on health.

This experience allows him to effectively bridge the gap between financial strategy and operational execution, ensuring that portfolio companies are well-positioned for success. His deep understanding of capital markets and financial accounting further enhances his ability to craft tailored investment strategies that maximize returns while mitigating risks.

About Ronald Homsy

As the Managing Director at Scopum Et Finem, Ronald Homsy leverages his extensive experience in hospitality management and travel technology to drive transformative change for clients in the industry. With a proven track record of scaling operations and enhancing profitability, Ronald has been instrumental in guiding companies through various stages of growth, from startups to established enterprises. His leadership at Forte Holding, where he successfully scaled the company to $70 million in sales and 800 employees, exemplifies his expertise in strategic planning and operations management.  
  
At Scopum Et Finem, Ronald focuses on delivering tailored advisory and consulting services that address the unique challenges faced by hospitality, travel, and leisure companies. His deep understanding of e-commerce and product innovation allows him to craft solutions that not only meet current market demands but also anticipate future trends. By integrating sustainability practices into operational strategies, Ronald helps clients enhance their brand value while contributing to a more responsible industry.  
  
Key projects under his direction include the development of comprehensive turnaround strategies for underperforming travel tech companies, where his negotiation skills and keen market insights have led to successful revitalizations. Ronald's commitment to excellence and his ability to foster collaborative relationships position him as a trusted advisor in the hospitality and travel sectors, making him a pivotal figure in shaping the future of these industries.

What types of swimming pool services does Superior Swimming Pools offer?

Superior Swimming Pools provides a comprehensive range of services including pool construction, renovation, maintenance, and repair. We specialize in both residential and commercial pools, offering custom designs to meet your specific needs. Our maintenance services include regular cleaning, chemical balancing, and equipment checks to ensure your pool remains in optimal condition year-round.

Can Superior Swimming Pools help with pool renovations?

Yes, we offer expert pool renovation services to update and enhance your existing pool. What types of pools does Superior Swimming Pools specialize in?

How often should I have my pool serviced?

The frequency of pool service depends on several factors including pool usage, location, and weather conditions. Generally, we recommend weekly maintenance during the swimming season to keep your pool clean and safe. However, during off-seasons or less frequent use, bi-weekly or monthly services may suffice. What financing options are available for pool construction?

About Yang Fang

As the Director and Head of Platform Software at DawnLight, Yang Fang plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of health technology through innovative software solutions. With a robust background in operating systems such as Android, Linux, and various real-time operating systems (RTOS) including ThreadX and VxWorks, Yang leads the development of cutting-edge applications that enhance health outcomes. His expertise in programming languages like C, C++, and Java enables him to architect complex software systems that are both efficient and scalable.  
  
Currently, Yang is spearheading several key projects aimed at integrating advanced audio decoding standards, including MPEG and AAC, into health monitoring devices. This initiative not only improves user experience but also ensures high-quality audio transmission, which is essential for telehealth applications. His deep understanding of HDMI protocols and digital rights management (HDCP) further enhances the interoperability of DawnLight's products within the healthcare ecosystem.  
  
In addition to his technical acumen, Yang is adept at utilizing a variety of development tools such as Git, Repo, and Lauterbach-Trace32, streamlining the software development lifecycle and ensuring robust debugging processes. His commitment to leveraging next-generation technology in health outcomes reflects a forward-thinking approach that positions DawnLight as a leader in the industry. With a focus on embedded software and IPTV solutions, Yang Fang is not only driving innovation but also redefining the standards for health technology in the digital age.

===========================

About Black Hole Recruiting Group
---------------------------------

Black Hole Recruiting Groups is primarily an engineering recruiting firm serving both candidates and employers alike.  
  
The recruiting process is broken. Candidates know it, employers know it, but few are doing anything to fix it.  
  
Candidates: You're on the wrong side of 50 years old, you were just "downsized", you sent out 100 resumes, you received 50 automated rejection e-mails (sometimes within minutes), heard back from 2 employers, never heard back from the rest, received 1 phone interview and received no feedback after that. Sound familiar?  
  
Employers: You posted a position on your website, received 200 external resumes, your recruiter (who may or may not have any experience recruiting for that role) looked through the first 50, ignored the other 150, sendt your hiring leader 5-6 candidates and you made an offer to the internal candidate you were 99% sure you were going to hire anyways. You just had 200 chances to enhance your brand and you failed. Sound familiar?  
  
Black Hole Recruiting Group was formed as a response to the aforementioned broken system. ----------------

Softpak offers an integrated logistics information solution to Harbour related companies such as Liner & Liner Agencies, Physical Distribution Companies (WMS), Freight Forwarders incl. Customs and Container Terminals and Depots. The customers of Softpak are located in the bigger ports in Europe (Rotterdam, Antwerp, Felixstowe, Dublin, Belfast etc.) and the rest of the world (Netherlands Antilles, Cuba, Saudi Arabia).  
  
More than 45 employees are continuously optimizing the software packages of Softpak to give the customers of Softpak a competitive edge versus the competition.  
Softpak is thereby continually investing in the product portfolio to deliver software products with a future.  
  
The head office of Softpak is located in Ridderkerk the Netherlands (5 kilometers from the city of Rotterdam). Box-IT bv, a subsidiary of Softpak specialized in Container Depot software, is located in Ridderkerk as well, while Softpak Belgium bv is situated in the port of Antwerp (Belgium). BoxVision bv, partly owned by Softpak and specialized in software for Container Terminals and Sales & Rental, is located in Ridderkerk.

About Groundfloor Finance
-------------------------

Groundfloor is the first and only private real estate lending marketplace open to non-accredited investors. Before Groundfloor, only accredited investors had access to the diversification, risk-adjusted returns & control available via private market investments. Groundfloor opens the door to short-term, high-yield returns backed by real estate. We bring together individual investors looking for short-term lending investments and borrowers looking for short-term financing for their specific real estate projects. Borrowers get access to more flexible, faster and cheaper capital than a traditional bank or a hard-money lender. Investors get access to short-term, high-yield investments offering returns that average over 10%.  
  
Since funding the first Groundfloor loan in 2014, thousands of individual investors have built their own portfolios of loans ranging in yield from 5% to 23%, on terms of 6 to 12 months, starting at a minimum investment of $10 per loan.  
  
Groundfloor earned a historic qualification by the SEC in August 2015 to sell private real estate debt investments to non-accredited investors. The company was founded in 2013 by Brian Dally and Nick Bhargava and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. Our fast-growing team is on a mission to benefit individual investors and the investments they fund by reformatting and opening private capital markets to broad public participation.  
  
Groundfloor has won numerous awards for our rapid growth and innovation, including Inc. Magazine's Inc. 5000 List and Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 List.

About Asim Aleem

As the Chief Financial Officer at Midtown Athletic Clubs, Asim Aleem plays a pivotal role in steering the financial strategy and operational excellence of a premier network of tennis and fitness clubs across the U.S. and Canada. With a commitment to fostering an environment that promotes active and healthy lifestyles, Asim is instrumental in aligning financial objectives with the company’s vision of creating world-class urban sports resorts. His expertise in financial analysis and modeling allows him to navigate the complexities of the fitness industry, ensuring sustainable growth and profitability.  
  
Under Asim’s leadership, Midtown Athletic Clubs has embarked on several key projects aimed at enhancing member experience and expanding its footprint. These initiatives include strategic partnerships that leverage technology to improve customer relationship management (CRM) systems, thereby enriching member engagement and retention. His background in business development and executive management equips him to identify and capitalize on new market opportunities, driving the company’s expansion into key metropolitan areas such as Atlanta, Chicago, and Montreal.  
  
Asim’s proficiency in equities and financial forecasting is complemented by his hands-on approach to hiring and team development, fostering a culture of excellence within the finance department. His strategic vision not only supports the financial health of Midtown Athletic Clubs but also contributes to the broader mission of inspiring communities to embrace healthier lifestyles. Through his leadership, the company is well-positioned to navigate the evolving landscape of the fitness industry while maintaining its commitment to quality and innovation.

About Jim Sharp

Jim Sharp is a seasoned National Account Executive at Intra-Cellular Therapies, where he plays a pivotal role in market access, policy, and advocacy, particularly in the chronic disease space with a focus on central nervous system (CNS) disorders. With a robust background in multi-payer segment reimbursement policy, Jim is adept at navigating the complexities of contract negotiations with national accounts across both commercial managed markets and Medicaid. His strategic approach to business planning and negotiations has consistently driven record results, even in the face of aggressive growth targets.  
  
Currently, Jim is preparing for the launch of Caplyta, the first atypical antipsychotic medication utilizing Lumateperone, which represents a significant advancement in intra-cellular signaling for the treatment of schizophrenia. His expertise in educational design and thought leadership allows him to effectively communicate the clinical and economic value of Caplyta to various stakeholders, including healthcare providers, payers, and government officials.  
  
Jim’s ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders is a cornerstone of his success. He understands the nuances of the pharmaceutical industry, leveraging his skills in pricing, product marketing, and sales effectiveness to create strategies that maximize field pull and ensure optimal access for patients. His experience with Indian Health Services and federal contracts further enhances his capability to engage with diverse healthcare systems, ultimately driving business growth and improving patient outcomes in the CNS space. As he continues to champion innovative therapies, Jim remains committed to advocating for policies that support patient access and enhance the quality of care in chronic disease management.

Emaar Entertainment has a unique portfolio of attractions that are truly innovative and transcend just entertainment or leisure. Its assets include some of the city’s most unique entertainment venues across The Dubai Mall and Dubai Marina Mall including Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo, Dubai Ice Rink, KidZania® and the recently launched attraction – VR Park. Highlighted by its philosophy to ‘inspire joy’, each attraction opens a door to an exceptional world of excitement for visitors.  
  
Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo is one of the largest indoor aquariums, featuring thousands of aquatic animals and a 270-degree walk-through tunnel; while KidZania®, is an innovative children’s ‘edutainment’ concept, provides a safe and realistic educational environment for children; while the Olympic-sized Dubai Ice Rink offers year-round entertainment and VR Park is a first-of-its-kind attraction for the Middle East designed to ‘Challenge Reality’, blurring the lines between perception and reality through unforgettable and mind-blowing experiences, spanning wholly immersive rides, interactive games and educational journeys.  
  
Emaar Entertainment also operates the Reel Cinemas at The Dubai Mall, Dubai Marina Mall and Jebel Ali Recreation Club. Reel Cinemas has set a new standard for cinemas in the region, pioneering the concept of up-market movie-going experiences and is today the go-to destination for movie-lovers.  
  
Committed to developing unparalleled leisure and entertainment choices, Emaar Entertainment will continue to expand its incredible portfolio of world-class leisure and entertainment attractions through new experiences, both in Dubai and around the world.

About Keck Graduate Institute
-----------------------------

Keck Graduate Institute (KGI), located at 535 Watson Drive in Claremont, California, stands as a pioneering institution in the realm of applied life sciences. Established in 1997, KGI is the first graduate school in the United States dedicated exclusively to education and research in this vital field. The institute offers a range of innovative postgraduate degrees and certificates that seamlessly integrate life and health sciences with business, pharmacy, engineering, and genetics. This interdisciplinary approach is designed to equip students with the necessary skills to tackle real-world challenges in healthcare and the life sciences industry.  
  
KGI is a proud member of The Claremont Colleges and is known for its entrepreneurial spirit and strong industry connections. These relationships provide students with unique pathways to become leaders in their respective fields. The institute comprises four distinct schools: the Henry E. Riggs School of Applied Life Sciences, the School of Medicine, the School of Pharmacy and Health Sciences, and the Minerva Schools at KGI. Each school emphasizes hands-on industry experiences, collaborative projects, and a curriculum that is responsive to the evolving needs of the healthcare sector.  
  
For those interested in the academic credentials of KGI's faculty, a comprehensive Keck Graduate Institute teachers list can be found on their website, showcasing the diverse expertise and backgrounds of the educators who guide students through their transformative educational journeys. With a commitment to fostering innovation and leadership, KGI continues to shape the future of applied life sciences education. More information about their programs and initiatives can be accessed at kgi.edu.

About Concord Lodge No. 625 F.&A.M.
-----------------------------------

Concord Lodge No. 625 is a shining jewel of history in Freemasonry located in Concordville, Delaware County, PA. Constituted 1902 as Concord Lodge No. 625 F. & A. M., under the jurisdiction of the Grand Lodge of Pennsylvania, to fulfill the desire of better men to establish a local Masonic Lodge, it laid the foundation to extend the Great Work and good deeds Freemasonry--the oldest and largest worldwide fraternity existing since time immemorial--fosters and promotes into the surrounding community and beyond.  
  
Freemasonry, in general, and Concord Lodge, in particular, is a private, members only fraternity of approximately 5,000,000 members worldwide with more than 400 in Concord Lodge. Counting among members past and present we comprise of top leaders in business, politics, academia, law, community service and medicine. Today, just as they did in 1902, they continue to contribute to Concord Lodge life, keep alive the tradition of the Ancient and Honorable fraternity of Freemasonry and continue to be luminaries in politics, business, culture and education.

About ADG Dienstengroep
-----------------------

WAAR EEN WIL IS, IS EEN WIJ  
  
Bij ADG steken tienduizenden hardwerkende mensen met de meest uiteenlopende achtergronden elke dag weer hun handen uit de mouwen. Zij verzetten bergen werk en zijn hiermee belangrijke schakels in de Nederlandse economie. Juist de doeners in onze maatschappij zorgen ervoor dat plannen daadwerkelijk tot uitvoer komen. Deze herkenning en erkenning is kenmerkend voor alle bedrijven binnen ADG. We zijn er trots op dat al deze mensen ervoor kiezen om bij ons te willen werken en dat stralen we uit.  
  
ADG staat voor:  
  
\* De wil om als betrokken werkgever te bouwen aan een inclusieve arbeidsmarkt, waarin iedereen meedoet en meetelt;  
\* De wil om mensen actief te ondersteunen met zorg, welzijn, wonen en werk om de kwaliteit van leven te verbeteren;  
\* De wil om maatschappelijke initiatieven te initiëren en aan te jagen waarvan iedereen profiteert.  
  
ADG dienstengroep is met haar groepsmaatschappijen actief in de sectoren Schoonmaak & Facility Management, Zorg & Welzijn en via deelnemingen in de sector Personeelsdiensten. Het zijn stuk voor stuk bedrijven met gemotiveerde en trotse medewerkers, die zich samen inzetten voor tevreden opdrachtgevers. Onze bedrijven zijn: HEYDAY, Asito, Reparaad, TSN Zorg en Welzijn, Ziezodan, The Maintenance Company, MB-All en Zorg Diensten Groep. We hebben deelnemingen in Timing, Youbahn, Persoonality en InPerson.

About America Reads\*America Counts
-----------------------------------

AR\*AC HISTORY  
The America Reads Challenge started as a national initiative whose goal was to ensure that every child in the United States read well and independently by the end of third grade. In December 1996, former University of Maryland President Kirwan was asked by the White House to join the America Reads College Presidents Steering Committee. Dr. Kirwan agreed, and in so doing, committed that the campus would use half of its substantial increase in Federal Work-Study funding for tutoring and related community service positions. He also pledged to direct additional campus resources to literacy activities. The University of Maryland became one of the first twenty universities to participate in America Reads. Currently, over 1,400 universities nationwide have America Reads programs.  
  
In March 1997, Dr. Kirwan established the President’s Task Force for America Reads. During the summer of 1997, the Task Force identified and invited eight elementary schools in Prince George’s County to participate in the program. These schools were selected by virtue of their proximity to campus, low reading scores, high poverty levels, and having a full-time Reading Specialist on Staff. During the Fall 1997 semester, the America Reads Staff recruited and trained more than sixty student mentors and placed them in the participating elementary schools to work with first and second grade students. In the spring of 1998, the number of Reading Mentors increased to eighty. In its second year, the program piloted the position of Team Leader, an opportunity for experienced Mentors to serve in a leadership capacity, assisting school personnel with administrative duties and acting as liaison between the school, the Reading Mentors on site, and the America Reads Staff on campus.  
  
Based on the success of the America Reads model at both the local and national level and resulting from the need for improvement in mathematics achievement, an America Counts Program, targeted at fourth graders, was implemented beginning in the 2000-2001 academic year. The partnership between the University of Maryland and the Prince George's County Public Schools expanded to embrace this new opportunity and was renamed America Reads\*America Counts to reflect this change. In 2006, America Counts expanded from one school to six schools as a result of funding from the American Honda Foundation.  
  
Partners in Print, added during the 2004-2005 school year, is the most recent addition to the America Reads\*America Counts office. Student presenters travel to Prince George’s County and Montgomery County schools to show parents how to help children become confident, successful readers. Each program, presented in English and Spanish, is geared toward children in kindergarten through second grade.  
  
OUR GOALS  
AR\*AC aims to:  
  
Provide a strong mentoring and tutoring experience for elementary school children in the Prince George’s County Public Schools, ultimately helping more children be successful in reading and math and reducing the impact of the achievement gap  
Help University of Maryland students understand the complexities of public K through 12 education and empower them to be education advocates  
Provide University of Maryland students with the opportunity for work experience, especially in the area of teaching, and provide professional development in teaching and leadership  
Enhance the relationship between the University of Maryland and its home community, Prince George’s County

Armed with an unwavering determination, Rosato embarked on a career that would allow him to inform and inspire millions of people through the power of journalism.  
  
Rosato's professional journey began in the early 1990s when he joined WABC-TV, the flagship station of the ABC network, as a reporter. He covered a diverse range of stories, from local politics to global events, and his reporting style always involved delving deep into the heart of the matter, aiming to provide viewers with a comprehensive understanding of the issues at hand.  
  
In 2003, Rosato transitioned to a new role as a morning anchor for Eyewitness News This Morning, becoming a familiar face in millions of households across the Tri-State area. Known for his warm and friendly personality, Rosato effortlessly guides viewers through the morning news routine, providing them with the information they need to start their day on the right foot. His insightful interviews and engaging reporting have made him a trusted source of information and a constant presence in the lives of his viewers.  
  
Beyond his role as an anchor, Rosato has also shown a strong commitment to his community. He has been actively involved in various charitable causes, advocating for issues such as education, healthcare, and equal rights. Rosato's genuine compassion and desire to make a positive difference in the lives of others have endeared him to many, both on and off the screen.  
  
In recognition of his outstanding contributions to journalism, Rosato has received numerous accolades throughout his career. He has been honored with several Emmy Awards for his exceptional reporting and anchoring, along with other prestigious industry recognitions. About California Controlled Atmosphere
--------------------------------------

Building on more than 25 years of experience, California Controlled Atmosphere (CalCA) is dedicated to providing the finest and most comprehensive service for our customer's industrial refrigeration needs.  
  
CalCA is an employee owned company. We specialize in mechanical systems design, installation, and maintenance for product cooling and cold storage/ freezer facilities. Today the company features a broad range of services including consulting expertise to help our clients comply with Risk Management Program (RMP) and Process Safety Management (PSM) regulations. Our controls department also provides the most advanced automated control and energy management systems using a wide variety of control platforms.  
  
Founded in 1984 by Ray Kliewer, the company has grown from a small family operation to a multi-million dollar corporation. Part of our success we attribute to our tenacity and willingness to take on the problems and challenges that others have backed away from. Another contributor is the effort and lengths that we take to stand behind our work which has led to many long-term relationships with our customers and accreditation by the Better Business Bureau of Central California (www.cencal.bbb.org). And today we are aggressively taking steps to keep our customers ahead of the curve with compliance issues, partnering to develop a comprehensive PSM software package.

About Ace & Tate
----------------

Same-old wasn’t working for us – so we created something new. Since arriving on the scene from Amsterdam in 2013, we’ve been changing the eyewear game with our thoughtfully designed frames, transparent pricing, and original collabs with some of the most exciting creative minds out there.  
  
We’ve got our eye on greater things still. Our goal is to be a driver of positive change in the eyewear industry for people and planet. We’ve made inroads as a B Corp. The endgame? Reach net-zero emissions by 2050.  
  
What we believe in:  
  
\- Come as you are  
  
We’re a diverse, international bunch — and we wouldn’t have it any other way. It’s what makes us unique, after all. We embrace inclusivity, champion equity, and respect all points of view. True to our Dutch roots, we’re down-to-earth and encourage everyone to be themselves. Always.  
  
\- Work hard, but take it easy  
  
Yes, we take the serious stuff seriously. We’re ambitious, hard workers, with big goals and ideas that require passion, effort, and collaboration. But we also try to have fun along the way! We celebrate our wins, share our failures, and bring optimism and positivity to every new challenge we face. Teamwork is where we get seriously good at what we do; we love challenging ourselves and learning from each other in order to move forward.  
  
\- Help us create actual change  
  
Our mission is to be a driver of positive change within the eyewear industry. We’re very proud to be a certified B-Corp, but we still have a long way to go. As a maker & seller of things, we know that the actions we take have an impact on both the natural environment and on the communities where we engage. We’re working hard to reduce our environmental impact, and to ensure our employees & wider stakeholders stay healthy, balanced, and are treated with respect and dignity.

About FoodStory Brands
----------------------

\- FoodStory Brands (FSB) is a team of food-obsessed experts in branding, prime sourcing, product development and logistics. We specialize in product innovation and speed-to-market solutions across all food and beverage categories in the nation’s leading food retailers. FSB is passionate about finding and developing new food and beverage products with compelling brand ideas that bring the best food stories to life from real people and places. Our mission is simply to bring authentic food stories to America’s table every day! Brands include:  
  
\- Fresh Cravings (freshcravings.com) - a line of refrigerated dips founded on freshness. You can find our salsa, hummus, and more where other natural products are located... in the produce and deli section.  
  
\- Cocktail Artist (cocktail-artist.com) - a line of premium bar ingredients and mixes developed by Award-Winning Mixologists. With no high fructose corn syrup and no artificial flavors or colors, Cocktail Artist makes it easy for the home bartender to mix high quality, craft cocktails for their friends and family.  
  
Why work here?  
In addition to a base salary, FSB offers quarterly staff bonus, up to 20% company contribution to 401K annually, and FREE financial planning. We offer best-in-class medical/dental/vision coverage with all premiums & annual deductibles paid for employees and their family/dependents. Our healthcare package also includes a complimentary company doctor, concierge healthcare including telehealth & FREE unlimited mental health therapy for employees and their family/dependents. Our new World Headquarters in Phoenix, AZ, offers a state-of-the-art wellness center, including a cardio loft, indoor/outdoor gym, FREE personal training and group fitness sessions, meditation room, recreation/BBQ area, and every employee has reserved covered parking. We also offer paid vacation, additional floating holidays, holidays, sick leave, community volunteer opportunities, plus much more!

About A.M. Qattan Foundation
----------------------------

An independent, not-for-profit developmental organisation working in the fields culture and education in Palestine and the Arab World, with a particular focus on children, teachers and young artists.  
Founded and registered in 1993 in the UK as a charity (no 1029450) and as a charitable company limited by guarantee (no 2171893), it has had a registered branch in Palestine as a non-profit organisation (no QR-0035-F) since 1998.  
  
  
Vision  
A just, free, enlightened and tolerant society with an active global presence; one that embraces dialogue and appreciates and produces knowledge, art and literature.  
  
  
Mission  
An independent institution working in the knowledge and creativity sectors, using an integrative approach and targeting a variety of social groups, particularly children, teachers and young artists. The Foundation seeks to empower free individuals and a dynamic Palestinian and Arab culture, through a long term, particularly developmental ethos. This is achieved through programmes that foster critical thinking, research, creativity and production of knowledge, aiming to provide inspiring models of giving, transparency and excellence.

About Akkroo
------------

Akkroo simplifies data capture, event check-in and registration with it's mobile application and service. Collecting thousands of pieces of data (names, emails, question responses) accurately and then acting up on them instantly is pretty much impossible with a paper-based system. Akkroo simplifies many of these tasks with customisable, instantly-validating forms which cuts out transcription, much human error and allows customers to process the data immediately - including sending event welcome emails instantly. Originally developed to fulfil an in-house need, external organisations quickly expressed an interest in using it for their own purposes after seeing it in use at conferences and events in the UK. Within a year the technology was being licensed for use by a several blue chip companies. In 2012 and following a ground-up rebuild by a newly-formed, dedicated development team and Akkroo became a stand alone entity with the remit to develop the business in new markets and locales.

About Joanna Newsom

Joanna Newsom is a distinctive and highly talented American singer-songwriter and actress whose ethereal voice and poetic songwriting have captivated audiences around the world. With her unique blend of folk, indie rock, and chamber pop, Newsom has carved out a place for herself in the music industry as one of its most unconventional and enchanting artists.  
  
Born and raised in Nevada City, California, Newsom began playing the piano at a young age and later learned to play the harp. It is this instrument that has become synonymous with her sound, setting her apart from the vast majority of musicians in the industry. Her delicate yet powerful vocals effortlessly weave intricate melodies over the harp, creating a magical and unforgettable listening experience.  
  
Newsom's debut album, "The Milk-Eyed Mender," was released in 2004 to critical acclaim. It showcased her exceptional songwriting skills and clever lyricism, drawing inspiration from a wide range of sources, including folklore, mythology, and even nursery rhymes. Tracks like "Sprout and the Bean" and "Peach, Plum, Pear" instantly established her as a visionary artist with a distinct voice and a penchant for storytelling.  
  
Her sophomore album, "Ys," released in 2006, further solidified Newsom's reputation as a boundary-pushing musician. Comprised of five lengthy tracks, each filled with lush orchestration and intricate arrangements, "Ys" is a mesmerizing exploration of love, loss, and the passage of time. Collaborating with renowned producer and composer Van Dyke Parks, Newsom created a sonic masterpiece that pushed the boundaries of traditional folk music and showcased her boundless creativity.  
  
In 2010, Newsom released her third studio album, "Have One On Me," a sprawling triple-album that cemented her status as a remarkable storyteller. With songs that range from tender ballads to jaunty folk tunes, Newsom demonstrates her versatility as a musician and her ability to create captivating narratives that transport listeners to another world. Standout tracks like "Good Intentions Paving Company" and "Baby Birch" showcase her ability to blend poetic lyrics with intricate melodies, creating a rich tapestry of sound that is uniquely her own.  
  
Apart from her music career, Newsom has also ventured into acting, appearing in films such as "Inherent Vice" and "Portlandia." Her compelling performances on-screen prove her versatility and ability to engage audiences in various artistic mediums.  
  
Throughout her career, Newsom has remained true to her artistic vision, eschewing mainstream trends and embracing her own unique style. ---------------

SmartTeam is a simple, affordably priced and fully hosted online solution for managing professional development and measuring employee and organizational performance. Developed for the small to medium business market, SmartTeam combines two world-class solutions in one to help companies assign, track and manage training as well as set goals and measure organizational performance with real-time visibility.  
  
The SmartTeam Learning Cloud features a targeted professional development course library with more than 100 courses on leadership and management, sexual harassment training, customer service, computer skills, and more—plus the ability to upload custom content and all the right tools to help you assign, track and manage training.  
  
The SmartTeam Performance Cloud is a complete online performance management and employee appraisal tool that consolidates and automates the goal-setting and appraisal process by providing everything business managers need in one easy-to-access location. It includes custom templates, competency assessments and appraisal forms.  
  
SmartTeam is easily accessible from any computer with Internet access and requires no additional hardware or server space.  
  
Owned by parent company VectorLearning, SmartTeam is based in Tampa, Florida. For more information call 1-866-565-7465 or visit www.SmartTeam.com.

About Orange Children & Parents Together (OCPT)
-----------------------------------------------

Orange Children & Parents Together, a nonprofit organization established in 1967, is committed to providing family-friendly, community-based programs that enhance children’s growth, strengthen families, and foster healthy communities.  
  
Orange Children & Parents Together has served over 23,500 at-risk preschool children since 1967. OCPT grew out of the Head Start Programs launched in 1965 as part of the War on Poverty. At OCPT we attend to the most fragile sector of our population: children ages 0 to 5 years old who are low income, English Language Learners, living in foster care, classified as homeless, struggling with special needs, and at-risk for chronic illness such as diabetes and asthma.  
  
Our programs focus on the full range of child needs in support of school readiness: health screenings, developmental screenings, individualized attention, educational outcomes, and successful transition into kindergarten. As our mission, we are committed to providing family-friendly, community-based child development programs that enhance children’s growth, strengthen families, and foster healthy communities in Orange County. By providing school readiness and family support programs to the most vulnerable children in our community, we are ensuring that all children begin school healthy and ready to learn, with the best possible family and community support available to them.

About Creative Associates International

Creative Associates International is a social impact company that provides outstanding, on-the-ground development services and forges partnerships to deliver sustainable solutions to global challenges.  
  
Creative's mission is to support people around the world to realize the positive change they seek.  
  
Founded in 1977 by four enterprising women, Creative’s experts focus on education, economic growth, governance and transitioning communities from conflict to peace, among other key areas.  
  
Thanks to the support of international clients, multilateral donors and the private sector, Creative has active programs in more than 30 countries—from Honduras to Nigeria and Ghana to Jordan. Since its founding, Creative has undertaken projects in more than 90 countries.  
  
Today, the company counts on a professional staff of more than 800 people around the world who are committed to working with officials, non-governmental organizations and community members to realize the positive change they seek.

Since 1998, PCs for People has been a driving force behind digital inclusion efforts across the US. Through an unwavering commitment to the communities we serve, we have connected over 300,000 people in all 50 states and Puerto Rico and recycled millions of pounds of electronics. Our services include free end-of-life IT asset management and certified data sanitization, technology refurbishing, computer distribution, computer repair, internet service, and technology education.  
  
We provide businesses with a Secure E-Waste Recycling Service which helps businesses eliminate electronic waste for free. Our recycling service provides:  
  
• AAA NAID certified data sanitization
